title: Traffic Routing / Shunt Rules
summary: Applies a routing mode to the active transport engine. Passwall and Passwall2 get the mode through their own settings (Iran Direct builds a shunt node); sing-box and Xray get a DayPass TPROXY rule set; WireGuard and OpenVPN get a DayPass policy route into the tunnel.

items.title: Iran Direct + Foreign Proxy (Recommended)
items.description: Passwall/Passwall2: builds the DayPass shunt node (protocol _shunt) whose default node is your selected proxy node and whose Iran rule (geosite:category-ir, geosite:ir, geoip:ir) goes direct, makes that shunt the active node and sets TCP and UDP proxy mode to proxy. Other engines: steers LAN traffic to the engine except private ranges and the CIDRs in /etc/daypass/proxy/routing/direct_v4.list (and direct_v6.list).
items.usage_tip: Select a node first: on Passwall the mode is refused while no proxy node is chosen. Without a direct list, WireGuard/OpenVPN send everything through the tunnel and sing-box/Xray rely on their own routing rules.

items.title: Global Proxy (All traffic via proxy)
items.description: Steers all LAN destinations, except private and reserved ranges, through the active engine.
items.usage_tip: Local sites become slower; use it mainly for testing or strict privacy needs.

items.title: Direct Only (Disable proxy)
items.description: Passwall: sets TCP and UDP proxy mode to disable, turns the engine off and points it back at your real node instead of the DayPass shunt. Other engines: removes the DayPass interception rules; the engine itself keeps running.
items.usage_tip: Handy for checking whether a problem comes from the proxy or the line.

items.title: Show current rules
items.description: Prints the saved routing mode, the engine it was applied to and the path of the generated nftables file.
items.usage_tip: Read-only: nothing is changed on the router.

items.title: Transport Engine (Select / start / stop)
items.description: Opens the transport engine menu to choose which installed engine DayPass drives.
items.usage_tip: Switching engines re-applies the saved routing mode to the new engine.

items.title: Back
items.description: Returns to the Proxy & Routing Manager.
items.usage_tip: The active routing mode stays applied.
